title: MarkItDown
brief: Microsoft's Python utility for converting PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, and other documents into clean Markdown for LLMs and text-analysis pipelines.
details: An X post from Matt Dancho about Microsoft's MarkItDown — a Python tool that converts almost any file (PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images) into clean Markdown, claimed at 100,000+ GitHub stars and trending. The link is the announcement; the repo wasn't directly linked. (x.com is not directly fetchable from this environment; the breakdown reflects the announcement's subject as curated.)
